notes.title: Attack of the Virtual Hugs Round 10!!
notes.notes:
Hello, there! ^w^

So, with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832380]the previous game[/url], I got in the habit of posting announcements where I decided to just give virtual hugs to my audience, in case someone reads it who is really struggling. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/355520/announcements/detail/3708195627368077605?snr=2___]You can read about it here.[/url]) Since then, I have been doing this semi-regularly for just about a year, now.

Now I'm including you in on the fun! :) So, you can either [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/355520/allnews/#scrollTop=1700]go back and read all of the nine previous posts[/url], or you can join us with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/355520/view/4243039938753332343]the most recent, tenth post where we are also having a good time![/url]

Hope to see you there! ːsteamdanceː

notes.title: Early Access Now Avaliable!
notes.notes:
Greetings fair citizens of the internet! Today I have officially released the Early Access Version for Centauri's Favourite Archer! Whether you're new here, or you hopped on over from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832380/The_Albino_Hunter_Revamp/]the previous game[/url], I hope you will enjoy the product I put out for you guys! :D

I've decided that it's probably a good idea to put together an outline of what my plans are going forward with the budgeting of this game, so [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2239960/discussions/0/6918175214321815359/]here is the list I put together.[/url] Otherwise, take care! ːsteamdanceː
